notes: Adds dated evidence integration (L745–776) omitted by the current card. All three existing mechanism IDs are retained; the vulnerability calculation is split from the old growth-stage-aware loss module because it also operates independently on the map. Forecast-loss prediction and hazard decision support are distinct source-supported work products; different hazards or states do not themselves establish cross-task reuse. No LLM training is contributed. Receipt safeguards are implementation claims without a reported process audit. Leave-one-year-out fitting is not chronological validation: other years include later years. Earliest crop inventories may be carried backward (L775–776), and external checks also guided index or label selection (L1501–1503). Thus temporal validity is not established. Decision uses remain unmeasured (L656–660).
